name: ChatGPT Work (agent mode of the unified ChatGPT desktop app, with bundled Codex)
cocheck_relevance: Codex threads in the same app are the confirmed hook path (hooks.json/config.toml hooks plus ~/.codex rollout files, as on the codex platform); local-only Work threads are documented as keeping 'supported hooks' but are untested. Cloud-orchestrated Work (including Work Cloud with local computer access) does not run command hooks, so CoCheck sees only filesystem effects there.

install.claim: The ChatGPT Mac app is /Applications/ChatGPT.app with CFBundleIdentifier com.openai.codex, executable ChatGPT, BundleSigningBaseName Codex: the former Codex app, renamed.
OpenAI merged the standalone Codex app into the ChatGPT desktop app on 2026-07-09 (Mac and Windows) and reportedly began sunsetting Atlas.
install.note: Secondary source via web search snippet; official OpenAI launch post not fetchable (403). Neowin's title and AI2Work say Chat, Work and Codex are switchable modes in one desktop app; AI2Work dates it 2026-07-09.

install.claim: Local computer access with Work Cloud requires ChatGPT desktop app 26.929 or higher.

processes_and_paths.claim: Bundled Codex CLI at Contents/Resources/codex-cli/bin/codex reports codex-cli 0.162.0-alpha.2; also bin/codex-code-mode-host and codex-resources/{voice,zsh}.

Electron app: Contents/Frameworks/Codex Framework.framework with helper apps (GPU, Renderer, Service, Alerts, Aperitif*); Sparkle updater; native modules incl. sky.node, browser-use-peer-authorization.node, remote-control-device-key.node.

Bundled plugins at Contents/Resources/plugins/openai-bundled; ~/.codex/config.toml enables plugins browser, code-review, codex-app-tools, computer-use, unified-computer-use, visualize (openai-bundled) and documents, pdf, presentations, spreadsheets, template-creator (openai-primary-runtime).
Computer-use helper: ~/.codex/computer-use/Codex Computer Use.app and separate com.openai.sky.CUAService (Group Container 2DC432GLL2.com.openai.sky.CUAService).
App runs an app-server: sockets ~/.codex/app-server-control/app-server-control.sock and ~/.codex/ipc/ipc.sock; daemon files in ~/.codex/app-server-daemon.

Other app dirs: ~/Library/Application Support/com.openai.codex (appcast bootstrap json only), ~/Library/Application Support/OpenAI/Codex, ~/Library/Logs/com.openai.codex/YYYY/MM/DD/, ~/Library/Preferences/com.openai.codex.plist.

auth.claim: Credentials live in ~/.codex/auth.json (existence confirmed only; not opened).

available.claim: Documented: when orchestration and execution are both local, supported hooks still work; the docs do not say command hooks are included for local-only Work threads. Not supported in cloud-orchestrated Work.

config.claim: Hooks load from ~/.codex/hooks.json, ~/.codex/config.toml [hooks], <repo>/.codex/hooks.json and config.toml (trusted projects only), plugin hooks/hooks.json, and managed requirements.toml.
No ~/.codex/hooks.json currently exists on this Mac; config.toml has no hooks table.

trust_or_approval.claim: Non-managed and plugin hooks must be reviewed and trusted (hash-bound) before running; /hooks reviews them; --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust bypasses for one invocation.

missing_events.claim: Work Cloud with local access and dots supports only admin-managed remote mcp_tool hooks set in Global requirements.toml; SessionEnd MCP hooks unsupported.
MCP hooks do not give a complete Compliance API audit trail; a PreToolUse callback error or timeout can fail without blocking the tool.

other_observation_channels.claim: Local executor in Work Cloud local access can export supported execution events to an OpenTelemetry collector (admin-configured); cloud orchestration events do not reach it.
Compliance API gives supported cloud audit records for local computer access with Work Cloud (enterprise admin only).
Plugins (skills + MCP servers + hooks) are shared between ChatGPT and Codex; local MCP apps run on the user's computer in ChatGPT Desktop. A plugin could be a CoCheck channel for MCP-exposed tools.
MCP config is in ~/.codex/config.toml, shared by desktop app, CLI and IDE extension.
Local thread index: ~/.codex/state_5.sqlite table threads (columns include rollout_path, cwd, title, sandbox_policy, approval_mode, model, originator, thread_source) plus session_index.jsonl.
Filesystem effects in the user's folders are observable regardless of orchestration.

call_ids.claim: PreToolUse and PostToolUse carry tool_use_id plus turn_id.

narration_sources.claim: Stop hook gives last_assistant_message (nullable); SubagentStop gives it too and agent_transcript_path.
Every hook carries transcript_path (nullable); format documented as not a stable interface.
Local rollout files under ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/ (existence and layout only) back threads via rollout_path.
narration_sources.note: Contents are documented by the codex researcher.

session_files.claim: ~/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD, archived_sessions, shell_snapshots, logs_2.sqlite, memories_1.sqlite, queue_1.sqlite, goals_1.sqlite exist.

helpers_or_subagents.claim: SubagentStart/SubagentStop events exist with agent_id and agent_type; subagents use the parent session_id.
state_5.sqlite has thread_spawn_edges and agent_nickname/agent_role columns.

limits_and_timeouts.claim: Hook timeout default 600 s; SessionEnd and Interrupt default 1 s (max 3); async hooks up to 8 concurrent per session.

update_channel.claim: Sparkle framework bundled; production-appcast-bootstrap.json in Application Support/com.openai.codex.

open_questions: Does a Work thread started in the desktop app default to local or cloud orchestration for a personal (non-Enterprise) account, and does that choice change which hooks fire? Docs mention an in-app Local/Cloud toggle, not its default.
Is 'ChatGPT Work' on personal Plus/Pro plans the same agent as on Business/Enterprise? Overview page says availability varies by plan and rollout.

Do local-only Work threads write rollout files in ~/.codex/sessions with the same shape as Codex threads? (Docs say history is not merged; not tested.) Check state_5.sqlite thread_source/originator values.
Official OpenAI launch post and help article 20001275 returned 403; launch date of Work (Neowin says July 2026) is secondary-sourced.
Does cloud-orchestrated local execution leave any local record CoCheck can read (e.g. in logs_2.sqlite)? Not examined.
